models.summary: Vision-language model for precise object localization, dense detection, and point-based localization across diverse domains with parallel box decoding.
Multimodal 12B instruction-tuned model with native text, audio, and image inputs, 256K context window, and support for 140+ languages.
MoE text-generation model with 8.3B total and 1.5B active parameters, optimized for on-device deployment and agentic reasoning tasks.
Uncensored 35B parameter MoE multimodal model with aggressive uncensoring and full vision capabilities without safety refusals.
Quantized GGUF version of Google's Gemma 4 12B instruction-tuned multimodal model with text, audio, and image inputs.
Multimodal 12B base model with native text, audio, and image understanding, 256K context window, and multilingual support.
198B-parameter sparse MoE vision-language model with selective reasoning levels, optimized for high-throughput agentic perception and reasoning workflows.
1B-parameter text-generation model using dual-timescale hierarchical reasoning architecture, pre-trained but not instruction-tuned or chat-aligned.
1B-parameter dense text-generation model designed for on-device deployment with hybrid reasoning and strong agentic tool-calling capabilities.
Text-to-image generation model using diffusion flow-matching and DiT architecture for high-quality image synthesis from text prompts.
